_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/rerank-check.mjs. The fixture eval (9 synthetic fixtures, about 40 conceptual pairs) measures the M2.2 structural prior as a small LOSS against plain RRF. The stronger instrument, the 61-task leakage-controlled corpus on this repository served hybrid, measures it as a large WIN: MRR 0.4169 with the prior, 0.3389 without, same tree, same index, same run (docs/bench/rerank-prior.md). So the prior stays on, and the gate stops demanding a fixture improvement the stronger instrument contradicts. It still refuses any change that makes the fixture delta WORSE than recorded here. Lower these numbers only with a new measurement on both instruments; raise them whenever a change improves them.

realCorpus.corpus: docs/bench/locate-corpus.json (61 tasks, base d872789840b47e2a2b2b9a5f0751288b6ad0a050, full variant)
